summary: Iteration 131 — Subscription Invoice Kit + HQ profile modal regression. Backend 16/16 pytest pass covering biller GET/PUT (bad GSTIN 400, valid 15-char GSTIN sets state_code to first 2 chars, restore to defaults), create-subscription returns invoice{number matching ^MC-2026-\d{4}$, email}, HQ invoices list contains new rows with all required fields + amount 12000, method 'upi', biller field NOT exposed, sequential invoice numbering (n and n+1), PDF downloads for invoice/receipt/terms return application/pdf with %PDF header and Content-Disposition attachment, unknown kind and unknown id return 404, POST /resend returns ok:true with sent_to + hq_to containing billing@/booking@/payments@ miracurl-suite.com, backfill idempotent (2nd call created=0), tenant /billing/invoices lists only own tenant (no biller field), tenant can download own PDF, cross-tenant invoice id returns 404, tenant blocked from /super-admin/invoices (403). Frontend HQ: /super-admin > Billing & Subscriptions tab renders invoices-panel; biller-identity-card expands, biller-legal_name='Miracurl AI Salon Suite', biller-save shows toast 'Billing identity saved — used on every new invoice'; hq-invoice-row-<id> present; hq-dl-invoice/receipt/terms each triggered playwright download events with .pdf filenames (Miracurl-invoice-MC-2026-0140.pdf, Miracurl-receipt-*.pdf, Miracurl-Terms-and-Conditions.pdf); hq-invoice-resend toast 'Sent to owner@elegance.com + HQ copies'; invoices-backfill toast '0 invoice(s) generated for older payments'. HQ profile modal regression at 1366x650: super-profile-edit-btn opens super-profile-modal; super-photo-upload-btn bounding_box y=88 (not cut off, fully visible at top); super-profile-save-btn visible+enabled after scroll; occupation change to 'Founder & CEO' saved with toast 'Profile updated', modal closed. Tenant /settings: settings-invoices-card lists invoice-row-<id> rows with invoice-amount-<id> showing ₹12,000; dl-invoice, dl-receipt and dl-terms each trigger .pdf download events.
critical_code_review_comments: subscription_invoice.issue_subscription_kit wraps entire flow in try/except to never break payment activation — good defensive design; error is logged with log.exception so failures are traceable.
next_invoice_number uses find_one_and_update with $inc + upsert + ReturnDocument.AFTER — atomic and safe for concurrent subs (verified two consecutive creates produced n and n+1).

_PUBLIC_FIELDS = {"_id": 0, "biller": 0} correctly hides both Mongo _id and internal biller identity from tenant/HQ list responses — verified in test_tenant_lists_only_own and test_hq_invoices_list_contains.
hq_invoice_resend re-fetches biller before email so identity edits take effect on resend without regenerating stored invoice — sensible.
backfill's existing-payment check builds a set from subscription_invoices.payment_id then skips — O(N) memory for up to 5000 rows is fine, but consider streaming/index if scale grows.

InvoicesPanel error toasts stringify e.response?.data?.detail only if it's a string; Pydantic validation errors (list of dicts) will fall back to generic 'Couldn't save' — could show more helpful message but not critical.
downloadInvoicePdf in lib/invoiceDocs.jsx uses blob + anchor click but doesn't URL.revokeObjectURL after — minor memory leak on repeated downloads.
